title: Allow multiple Sticky Note applets to reference the exact same note (useful with external screen)
line: A Sticky Note widget can now show the same note as another Sticky Note widget, and edits in one appear in the other.
explanation: Every Sticky Note widget always had its own note file, and since 6.5 two widgets asking for the same file get separate copies (so cloned panels don't share by accident), so the widgets on two screens' panels could not show one note. The settings page now has a "Note:" choice listing the notes of the other Sticky Note widgets; picking one stores it as the widget's shared note (its own note is kept for switching back), the copy-on-clone logic only applies to widgets using a note as their own, and removing a widget no longer trashes a note another widget still shows. Each widget now only writes text that was changed in it and otherwise follows the file (re-reading it when it gets focus), so a widget never overwrites newer text from the other one with its stale copy.

commits.message:
applets/notes: allow showing another widget's note

Each Sticky Note widget always had its own note, so with a panel on each
screen there was no way to keep one note in both. The settings now offer
to show another widget's note, and edits made in either one are kept.

BUG: 515504

media.caption: Sticky Note settings before: no way to pick which note the widget shows; each widget always has its own
Settings of the panel's Sticky Note (new Kirigami.Forms page): the "Note:" choice offers the desktop note "Call the dentist"
After choosing it, the panel note shows the same text as the desktop notes
A line typed in the panel, then one typed right away on the desktop: both widgets end up with both lines
Previous version of this patch: type in the left note, click the right one and type at once; the right note saves its stale copy and the left note's text is lost
Same steps now: the bottom note picks up the top note's text when it gets focus, and both edits are kept
